q: Which car front gave the smallest force on the dummy?
How many times longer did the crumple zone take to stop than the rigid front?
Predict the force on the dummy with the crumple zone, with a reason.
About 18 kN: 3.3 times longer stopping time gives about 3.3 times smaller force (60 / 3.3).
Explain, using F = m × change in v / t, why a longer stopping time is safer.
The same change in velocity happens over a longer time, so the deceleration and force on the body are smaller: fewer injuries.
